source_text: In carcere interpretatur somnia. Tres palmite — triduum; canistrum — iudicium. Memoria et oblivio.
pass_a_gloss: In prison he-interprets dreams. Three shoots — three-days; basket — judgment. Memory and forgetfulness.
pass_b_english: In prison he interprets dreams. [[Three vine shoots — three days >> Bible:Genesis 40:9-13]]; [[the basket — judgment >> Bible:Genesis 40:16-19]]. Memory and forgetfulness.
